# Absolute everything today (2026-08-02)

Source truth: channel re-sweep `Server Handoffs/Ava Ivy/reports/channel-dumps-2026-08-02-resweep/` (~18:55Z), [`urgent-registry.json`](Server%20Handoffs/Ava%20Ivy/data/urgent-registry.json), open jobs, prior full-day plan (waves 0–8 done).

**Defaults locked (no waiting):**
- Deploy Worker so weekly-awards code fixes go live today.
- Open constitution ratification as a formal Discord PROP (draft already exists; poll not clearly opened).
- Post explicit Linux-ops focus request in Slack `#development-feed` (Alex required the ask).
- Continue Official hold; no jar for Root-Ava-Core; no $100 spend until votes pass.
- Park elite-skills / ban→vote-weight / full Ubuntu cutover / kick Official.
- **Ava progress updates as-you-go** — every completed item gets a short Ava post (see standing rule below). Do not batch silence until EOD.

---

## Standing rule — Ava updates along the way

After each discrete finish (deploy, PROP open, dig milestone, gate clear, figure-out advance), Ava posts **once** via `post-as-ava` / `avaPost` — no Cursor Slack MCP.

| What finished | Where Ava posts |
|---|---|
| Dig / code / deploy / ops | Slack `#development-feed` (primary); `#ops-feed` or `#work-log` only if ops-facing |
| Player-facing (awards fix live, constitution PROP, channel pin, Pro/rewards) | Discord `#updates` (short); never dump dig essays into `#admins` / `#general` |
| Gate cleared / needs Alex hands / EOD | Telegram operator DM only |
| Multi-room spam | Never all-Slack-channels blast again today unless Alex asks |

Format: 3–6 lines, what shipped, what’s next, any gate still on Alex. Multipost only if needed. Prefer edit of prior status post when correcting the same beat within ~15 minutes.

Wire into every phase: Phase A–F steps end with “Ava update” before moving on.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  verify[Verify_1_8_0_and_deploy]
  gates[Alex_human_gates]
  awards[Awards_and_governance]
  digs[Active_digs]
  people[People_and_DMs]
  hygiene[Hygiene_and_EOD]
  verify --> gates
  verify --> awards
  awards --> digs
  digs --> people
  gates --> hygiene
  people --> hygiene
```

---

## Already done this morning (do not redo)

- Wave 0–8 full-day plan delivery (Slack all-channels brief, Discord pointer, manipulation gate, Llama docs, PROPs, desktop MVP, token/reserve, morning log check, EOD Telegram).
- Weekly awards **code** fixes (bot exclusion + claim-before-post) in [`rootmc-activity-bots.ts`](Web%20Files/rootmc-realm-api/src/rootmc-activity-bots.ts) / [`rootmc-weekly-activity-awards.ts`](Web%20Files/rootmc-realm-api/src/rootmc-weekly-activity-awards.ts) — **not live until Worker deploy**.
- Figure-out opener DM to `lodge_0xcc7` (session active, 0 turns).
- Alex Discord DM reply to `gm princess`.
- D→E Work Stations mirror sync finished (re-sync after outages as needed).
- Channel rules locked: Discord players/cloud; Slack all digs; `#admins` fires only; `#general` chat only; `#development` pointer.

---

## Phase A — Close the 1.8.0 / awards contradiction (first 30–60 min)

**Problem:** Slack claims RCON 1.8.0 live (~02:02) but 18:02 brief still gates on Shockbyte restart.

1. **Alex:** Confirm Claims + Towny jars are `1.8.0`, Core enables, Skills MySQL pool ready, no zip END errors; clear any leftover `waiting_restart` narrative in registry/jobs.
2. **Agent:** Run [`Web Files/rootmc-api/deploy.ps1`](Web%20Files/rootmc-api/deploy.ps1) so awards bot-exclusion + anti-triple-post ship.
3. **Agent:** Spot-check `#general` award roles (remove Ava bot from Top Participator role if present); note empty in-game Top Active = link/playtime (player push, not code fail).
4. Update urgent `ops-bond-reserve` after live ledger glance (Claims vs Towny isolated; pause if < 0).
5. **Ava update** — Slack `#development-feed`: Worker deployed / awards fixes live; 1.8.0 verify status; reserve note. Discord `#updates` only if player-visible awards role cleanup happened.

---

## Phase B — Human gates (Alex; unblock everything else)

| Gate | Action | Unblocks |
|---|---|---|
| `ava.rootmc.net` | Cloudflare Tunnel + Access → `:8787` | Remote Ava status |
| Root-Ava-Core | After PROP vote (or soft docs-only hold): jar yes/no | Plugin code |
| Official bot | Keep installed until [`rootmc-bot-parity.md`](Server%20Handoffs/Ava%20Ivy/notes/rootmc-bot-parity.md) green + sign-off | Safety |
| OptiPlex Ubuntu | Keep E mirror hot; full cutover parked | Host future |
| Website ~$100 | Vote only; **no spend** until pass | Marketing tools |

Mark [`urgent-registry.json`](Server%20Handoffs/Ava%20Ivy/data/urgent-registry.json) items done as each clears. **Ava Telegram** Alex on each clear (or each hard block); no Discord noise for tunnel/OptiPlex internals.

---

## Phase C — Governance already open (run the votes; don’t re-draft)

Open now in Discord `#voting` / forum `#proposals`:
- **PROP Root-Ava-Core** — docs today; no jar until Alex greenlights after vote.
- **PROP Website ~$100 USD** — no spend until pass.

**Open new today:**
1. **Constitution ratification PROP** — Ava role, live 75%/60% gates vs stale pin/wiki (`2026-07-06` / `2026-07-16`), pin version bump. Draft exists from earlier dig; post formal vote (Alex already asked for update).
2. **Clarify reaction→vote-factor** — announced in `#updates` without clear PROP; fold into constitution PROP text.

**Ava update after PROP open:** Discord `#updates` pointer + Slack `#development-feed` one-liner that constitution vote is live.

**Leave blocked (no implement):**
- `job-ms9p5x2i` Ban boats  
- `job-ms9qv1q2` Core-Node expand  
- `job-ms9s7pa0` Hourly snapshots + pending proposals  

---

## Phase D — Active digs (Slack `#development-feed` only)

1. **Solar circus + shackas** — finish EcoFlow hookup (Delta 2 `R331ZAB5SG6S2858`, River 2 Pro `R621ZA16XH6K1155`): milliwatt→watt buckets, minute totals, signature/SOC, cucumbers/shackas same pass. **Ava update** mid + done on `#development-feed`.
2. **Skills dead blocks** — when Melee drops the block list, audit Root-Skills triggers and patch; until then park with DECISION note. Ava notes park or patch.
3. **Official parity soak** — advance checklist items that are Ava-owned without kicking Official; keep slash/cron as Worker until parity green. Progress note on Slack only.
4. **Post Linux-ops focus request** in `#development-feed` (explicit ask for greenlight) — that ask *is* the Ava update.
5. **Answer unanswered Slack asks:** RootRecord shared Ava imaging/Kilauea; Melee Towny-through-26.3 (answer: stays on roadmap per brief). Reply in-thread; no separate blast.
6. **Development pin one-liner** on Discord `#development` (pointer + staff invite, no bare Slack login trap for players). Tiny `#updates` if players need the pointer.

---

## Phase E — People / DMs

1. **lodge_0xcc7 figure-out** — session active; absorb replies into [`figureOutMode.mjs`](Web%20Files/rootmc-ava/src/figureOutMode.mjs) factors; one natural follow-up if they answer; complete after ~6 turns. **Ava Telegram** Alex only when figure-out completes or stalls (not every DM turn).
2. Keep Alex Telegram as master ops (dumps/urgents/progress + EOD).
3. Melee Discord DM: no new dig unless he pings; respect cooldown.

---

## Phase F — Hygiene + end of day

1. Keep channel dumps / urgent Telegram schedules running.
2. Re-sync `D:\.1 Work Stations` → `E:\.1 Work Stations` after large ship waves / outages.
3. Deduplicate daily summary double-posts smell (note only unless easy Worker guard).
4. `#mobile-app` stale ETA — short status update or Slack redirect.
5. Confirm dream/cloud-dark state: if still dark, note in Telegram; Discord soft answers stay constrained.
6. **EOD Telegram:** rollup of all as-you-go updates — what shipped (incl. Worker deploy), what’s waiting on Alex, parked list, lodge figure-out status. No duplicate all-Slack blast.

---

## Explicitly not today

- Elite root-skills / full mcMMO replace  
- Ban→vote-weight constitution change (beyond documenting need)  
- Full OptiPlex Ubuntu cutover  
- Kick RootMC Official before parity  
- Spend ~$100 website tools before vote  
- Root-Ava-Core live jar before greenlight  

---

## Success criteria (rest of day)

- [ ] Worker deployed; awards fixes live  
- [ ] 1.8.0 formally verified / registry updated  
- [ ] Constitution PROP opened in `#voting`  
- [ ] Solar/shackas dig advanced or blocked with clear next step  
- [ ] Linux-ops focus request posted in Slack  
- [ ] Unanswered Slack asks answered (imaging, Towny 26.3)  
- [ ] Discord `#development` pin pointer posted  
- [ ] Lodge figure-out continued if they reply  
- [ ] Urgent registry reflects gate clears  
- [ ] Ava posted as-you-go updates (Slack digs / Discord `#updates` / Telegram gates) — not only EOD  
- [ ] EOD Telegram clean
